source_metadata.title: EASY: Towards Efficient LLM-Based Agentic System

coverage.quantitative_cell_policy: Every numeric result cell in Tables 1-6 and Figure 4 was atomized; AIME24/25 paired cells were split into separate atoms.

main_text_figure_inventory.Figure 1: not separately atomized; conceptual comparison restated by text atoms
main_text_figure_inventory.Figure 2: represented by method atoms for system design and training pipeline
main_text_figure_inventory.Figure 3: represented by method atoms for tree-structured rollout
main_text_figure_inventory.Figure 4: all plotted numeric efficiency values atomized
main_text_figure_inventory.Figure 5: authors' qualitative usage trends atomized; coordinates not digitized
main_text_figure_inventory.Figure 6: authors' qualitative training-dynamics trends atomized; coordinates not digitized

extraction_limitations: Figure 1 is conceptual background and was not atomized separately because its content is restated in the introduction.
Figure 3 is a schematic of the rollout process and was represented through method atoms rather than image-specific atoms.
Figure 5 and Figure 6 were atomized at the authors’ stated qualitative-trend level; exact plotted time-series coordinates were not digitized.
Bibliographic references were not converted into literature atoms.
The complete wording of every prompt and tool-card field was not atomized line by line; operative constraints and configurations were extracted.
No funding, conflict-of-interest, or data-availability statement was located in the provided preprint; no such atom was fabricated.
Table 2 labels its second metric as Cost while the caption and prose describe performance and efficiency; atoms preserve this ambiguity explicitly.
All atoms remain needs_review because extraction was performed by a language model without human verification.
